maddeler.e:
نندفق (form VII)
# نَنْدَفِقُ (nandafiqu) /nan.da.fi.qu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْدَفَقَ (indafaqa)
# نَنْدَفِقَ (nandafiqa) /nan.da.fi.qa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْدَفَقَ (indafaqa)
# نَنْدَفِقْ (nandafiq) /nan.da.fiq/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْدَفَقَ (indafaqa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
